Delta P_1: Pressure drop in the first of two readings
Delta P_2: Pressure drop in the second of two readings
L: Length of the pipe between the taps
P: Pressure (ΔP: pressure drop between the taps)
Q_1: Flow rate in the first reading
Q_2: Flow rate in the second reading
h: Height of liquid in a manometer tube (Δh: their difference)
